configuration: memory settings, connection limits, checkpoints, WAL, and planner parameters, and the ability to audit an existing configuration and justify every change Query performance analysis own after an engagement Capacity planning and performance baselining Major version upgrades and schema migrations with minimal downtime Working within change management processes in large, regulated enterprises Security hardening: roles and privileges, pg_hba configuration, TLS, and auditing (pgAudit) Running Postgres on Kubernetes (CloudNativePG, Crunchy Postgres Operator, or similar) Scripting
